**Stable ID:** `DATA-02.03` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 02 Dataset discovery and source inventory

Inventory datasets published by government agencies, statistical offices, standards bodies and intergovernmental organizations.

## Deliverables

- Source inventory by jurisdiction and publisher
- Candidate list with official landing pages

## Canonical artifact paths

- `research/sources/official.md`
- `catalog/proposals/`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Each candidate cites the official publisher landing page with an access date

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each publisher records jurisdiction, open-data license family and access method
- [ ] Regional restrictions are captured as observed
- [ ] Candidates are proposals only

## Non-goals

- Legal interpretation of government licenses beyond recorded terms

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-02.03.T1` Inventory publishers
  - [ ] `DATA-02.03.T1.S1` List national open-data portals
  - [ ] `DATA-02.03.T1.S2` List standards and intergovernmental publishers
  - [ ] `DATA-02.03.T1.S3` Record license families
- [ ] `DATA-02.03.T2` Collect candidates
  - [ ] `DATA-02.03.T2.S1` Record identity and landing pages
  - [ ] `DATA-02.03.T2.S2` Record jurisdiction and region notes

## Dependencies

- Blocked by `DATA-02.01` Discovery method and source-use policy
- Blocked by `DATA-04.01` Dataset identifier and publisher model

- Rights reviewer
- Approval must come from someone other than the author of the change and must cover the latest push.
